author: Kevin Kelly
description: Per-server XP and levels from messages, reactions, voice participation, and Discord slash commands, with configurable curves, leaderboards, announcements, and import/export tools. Use [p]rank and [p]leaderboard, with matching slash commands and /level settings. Adds milestone roles, weekly/monthly/seasonal earned-XP rankings, scoped temporary boosts, configurable farming limits, and a guided setup panel. Includes earned achievement badges, configurable weekly challenges, and themed PNG rank cards.
short: XP, milestone roles, seasonal rankings, boosts, and farming controls.
install_msg: Load with [p]load levelplus, then use [p]level help and [p]level diag. XP sources start enabled. To pause collection, disable message, reaction, and voice XP and set [p]level restrict toggles slashxp false. Review levelplus/README.md for restriction behavior. Enable slash commands as the bot owner with [p]slash enablecog levelplus, then [p]slash sync. New: use [p]level setup, [p]level rewards, [p]level guard, and [p]periodboard. Use [p]achievements, [p]challenges, [p]rankcard, and [p]level challenges enabled true.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server leveling settings, XP totals keyed by user ID, and saved display names or aliases. XP and aliases persist when members leave. Message contents are inspected to count words but are not stored. Cooldown timestamps are held in memory. Admins can export users with XP rows through exportcsv, remove individual XP rows through remove/removeid, and clear all XP and aliases for a server through clear yes. Individual XP removal does not remove saved aliases. Red user-data export and deletion hooks return or remove XP and aliases across servers. Additional sections store reward role IDs, boost scopes/expiry, farming settings, 35 dated member XP buckets, current season totals, five top-50 season archives, and daily cap counters. Red data hooks export/delete these per-user records. Duplicate-message hashes and reactor/message IDs stay in bounded memory. Stores per-member earned XP, badge IDs/times, current weekly challenge counters/completions, and pending earned reward XP. Data hooks export/delete these records. Rank PNGs are rendered locally in memory and are not stored by the cog.
